_about: DEMO DATA. Every company, role, person and date here is fictional. Dates written as @d-N / @t-N mean N days before the day the demo is opened (date only / full timestamp). "postings" holds fictional job descriptions that the demo serves in place of the Greenhouse, Ashby and Lever APIs, keyed <ats>/<slug>/<job id>; Watermark Climate has none, to show a closed posting. Four roles also carry a copy as descriptionHtml, the way a scan stores one, so the demo shows Preview on them.

greenhouse-1001.title: Senior Product Manager, Utility Data
greenhouse-1001.fitNote: Utility rate and interconnection data maps straight to past pricing and utility-data work. Gap: no hardware experience.

ashby-1002.title: Staff Product Manager, Virtual Power Plants
ashby-1002.fitNote: Strong energy domain match; staff scope asks for prior platform ownership across three teams.
ashby-1002.descriptionHtml:
Gridlark (a fictional demo company) turns home batteries and thermostats into virtual power plants that utilities can dispatch.

As Staff Product Manager, Virtual Power Plants, you will set product direction across our enrollment, dispatch and settlement teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own the VPP platform strategy across three product teams
  • Work with utility partners to design programs homeowners actually join
  • Define how we measure grid impact and customer payouts
  • Coach senior PMs and raise the bar on product thinking

Requirements

  • 8+ years of product management, including platform ownership across several teams
  • Energy, utility or IoT experience
  • Strong written communication

Base pay $185K to $220K. Remote (US).

greenhouse-1005.title: Senior Product Manager, Checkout
greenhouse-1005.fitNote: Checkout and point-of-sale financing are core strengths. Fintech is weighted lower in the criteria.
greenhouse-1005.descriptionHtml:
About us

Ledgerly (a fictional demo company) builds checkout and financing tools for independent retailers.

The role

As Senior Product Manager, Checkout, you'll own the moment a customer pays: payment methods, point-of-sale financing and the conversion funnel.

What you'll do

  • Own checkout conversion end to end, from cart to confirmation
  • Launch pay-over-time options with lending partners
  • Run experiments on payment method ordering and messaging
  • Partner with risk and compliance on disclosures

What you bring

  • 5+ years in product, with at least 2 in payments, checkout or lending
  • A record of moving conversion with experiments
  • Comfort working with partners, legal and compliance

$175,000 to $210,000 base. Remote, US.

himalayas-1006.title: Senior Product Manager, Membership
himalayas-1006.fitNote: Mission fit; consumer membership is new ground after B2B platforms.

greenhouse-1007.title: Senior Product Manager, Installer Platform
greenhouse-1007.fitNote: Installer and channel-partner tooling is a direct match.
greenhouse-1007.descriptionHtml:
About us

Brightwell Solar (a fictional demo company) runs a network of independent solar installers across 20 states.

The role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the Installer Platform, the tools our partners use to quote, sell and schedule installs.

What you'll do

  • Own the installer portal: onboarding, quoting, permits and scheduling
  • Talk with installers every week and turn what you hear into a clear roadmap
  • Ship pricing and tiering tools for different partner levels
  • Track partner activation and retention

What you bring

  • 5+ years of B2B product management
  • Experience with channel partner or marketplace products
  • Energy or home services background is a plus

ashby-1008.title: Senior Product Manager, Merchant Risk
ashby-1008.descriptionHtml:
Pebblepay (a fictional demo company) processes card payments for small online merchants.

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager, Merchant Risk to help good merchants get paid fast while keeping fraud and losses low.

What you'll work on

  • Merchant onboarding and underwriting flows
  • Rules and models that flag risky activity, with clear review queues
  • Reserve and payout policies, and how we explain them to merchants

About you

  • 5+ years in product, ideally in payments, lending or risk
  • Comfort with data, rules engines and trade-offs between growth and loss

Compensation: $180K to $215K base. Remote, US.

postings.greenhouse/sunfield/1001:
About us

Sunfield Energy (a fictional demo company) helps homeowners understand what solar and batteries will really save, using utility rate and interconnection data from hundreds of utilities.

The role

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own our utility data platform: the rate schedules, tariffs and interconnection rules every quote depends on.

What you'll do

  • Own the roadmap for utility data ingestion, validation and coverage
  • Partner with data engineering to cut the time to add a new utility from weeks to days
  • Define quality metrics for rate accuracy and make them visible to sales and operations
  • Work with installers and sales teams to find where bad data costs deals

What you bring

  • 6+ years of product management, ideally with data or platform products
  • Comfort with messy, rule-heavy domains like rates, pricing or tariffs
  • Experience shipping human-in-the-loop or automated extraction workflows
  • Clear writing and a habit of measuring outcomes

Compensation: $170,000 to $205,000 base, plus equity. Remote in the US.

lever/orbitline/1004.description:
Orbitline (a fictional demo company) sells satellite imagery and analytics to insurers, farms and governments through a developer API.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Earth Observation API: how developers find, order and process imagery.

lists.content:
• Own the public API roadmap and developer experience
  • Work with partners to launch new imagery products
  • Measure activation, usage and revenue per account

• 5+ years of product management, with API or platform products
  • Experience working with partners and enterprise customers
  • Geospatial or imagery experience is a plus

lever/orbitline/1004.additional: This is a fast-paced team. Salary range $175K to $195K. Remote in the US.

lever/copperleaf/1011.description:
Copperleaf Insurance (a fictional demo company) is rebuilding how home insurance claims get handled.
As Senior Product Manager, Claims Automation, you'll use document extraction and rules to settle simple claims in hours instead of weeks.

lists.content:
• Own the claims intake and automated review flow
  • Work with adjusters to design human-in-the-loop review
  • Track cycle time, accuracy and customer satisfaction

• 5+ years of product management
  • Experience with document AI or workflow automation
  • Insurance experience is helpful but not required
